gloss: sense of guilt, feeling of indebtedness

definitions.gloss: sense of guilt, feeling of indebtedness, feeling of owing
definitions.explanation: A persistent feeling of guilt or moral debt toward someone, often because one feels they have done something wrong or have not done enough. Implies an emotional burden that weighs on the conscience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{負|お}い{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a sense of guilt toward him.

examples.japanese: {負|お}い{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I can't be firm with her because I feel indebted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧こと⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負|お}い{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The feeling of indebtedness for being helped has stayed in my heart.

notes:
USAGE:
{負|お}い{目|め} is most commonly used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel) or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have). It describes an internal emotional state — not a financial debt, but a moral or emotional one. People with {負|お}い{目|め} often feel they cannot assert themselves or refuse requests from the person they feel indebted to.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負|お}い{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel a sense of guilt
- {負|お}い{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a sense of indebtedness
- {負|お}い{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to carry a sense of guilt
- {負|お}い{目|め}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without guilt

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{罪悪感|ざいあくかん}→罪悪感：05951_zaiakukan⟧ (guilt, guilty conscience) is stronger and implies wrongdoing. {負|お}い{目|め} is softer — it can arise simply from receiving help or having an advantage, not necessarily from doing something wrong.
